sourceSeeds.name: Small Business Export Loan
sourceSeeds.description: An ongoing $20,000–$350,000 loan pathway for eligible Australian small businesses, including export-related working capital and plant or equipment.
criticalConditions: Finance must support export-related activity or a credible export plan.
Applicant must have an ACN, at least two years of trading history, annual turnover above $250,000 and demonstrated profitable operations.

sourceSeeds.name: SEDI Capability Building Grants 2026–27
sourceSeeds.funderName: Australian Government Department of Social Services / Impact Investing Australia
sourceSeeds.description: Rolling grants of up to $120,000 for eligible Australian social enterprises to purchase capability-building services.
criticalConditions: Applicant must directly benefit people experiencing entrenched disadvantage and satisfy the trading-revenue threshold.
Funds purchase capability-building services; they are not general production equipment or unrestricted operating cover.

sourceSeeds.name: auDA Community Grant Program 2026
sourceSeeds.description: A current national community grant round for ACNC-registered not-for-profits, with rural, remote and First Nations priority groups.
criticalConditions: The project must create a direct digital-inclusion or internet-utility outcome, not merely serve a priority community.
